title: ARC-RGBT
description: We combine visible and thermal imagery to study object detection under difficult conditions and the reliability limits of sensor fusion.

title: ARC-RVI · Autonomous Visual Inspection
description: We develop methods for robots to locate targets, plan viewpoints, and assess the completeness and quality of visual inspection records.

title: ARC-HRI-SAFETY
description: We design predictive risk-assessment methods for human–humanoid collaboration, combining scene perception, motion analysis and safety constraints.

title: ARC-AFFECTIVE
description: We study moment-to-moment attention and cognitive workload during tasks, including XR environments. We combine Muse S Athena EEG with behavioural data to develop and validate personalised estimates of user state.

title: ContextNDD
description: We develop a context-sensitive framework for behavioural analysis that respects individual differences rather than relying on diagnostic labels alone.

title: SAPIENS · Human–Humanoid Interaction
description: We study how direct interaction with a humanoid robot shapes trust, agency, social presence and the perception of emotional cues.

title: ARC Mobile Eye Tracking
description: We investigate smartphone-based gaze estimation and how calibration, lighting and head movement affect measurement accuracy.

title: EEG Neurolyze
description: We develop Muse S Athena EEG acquisition and analysis tools with data-quality checks. The platform is intended to support cognitive experiments and event synchronisation, including future XR integration; physical recordings still require validation.

title: S4D-TAM · Autonomous Navigation
description: We design evaluation methods for autonomous navigation in GNSS-degraded environments using scene semantics and 3D/4D spatial information.

title: ARC Attachment Dynamics
description: We combine attachment psychology with dynamic modelling to study changes in closeness, autonomy and perceived security in relationships.

title: ARC-ADHD · Adaptive Research Game
description: We design a research game to study recovery of goal-directed behaviour after a challenge, distinguishing task improvement from real-world transfer.

title: AI Cognitive Resilience
description: We investigate whether AI responses shift beliefs through evidence quality or through persuasive wording and presentation.

sourceTitle: DERA-HRI · Emocje w interakcji z robotem
title: DERA-HRI · Emotions in Robot Interaction
description: We develop a research instrument for describing emotional experiences after robot interaction, including responsiveness, trust and control.

title: MindDx · Psychological Assessment Simulator
description: An interactive educational environment for case analysis, hypothesis formation and diagnostic decision-making without risk to real patients.

title: ARIANA
description: A multimodal affect-research platform concept combining eye tracking, visible/infrared imaging, movement sensing and psychometrics.

title: PIAST · Satellite Earth Observation
description: Work within a three-nanosatellite Earth-observation programme advancing Polish optoelectronics and imaging capabilities.

title: SEEKER · Optoelectronic Seekers
description: Development of multispectral and imaging optoelectronic systems for defence applications, including prototyping and verification.

title: PolFEL · Free-Electron Laser
description: Participation in the development of Poland's first free-electron laser infrastructure for studying ultrafast processes in matter.

title: OPTOKRYPT · Quantum Cryptography
description: Research into optical information-security technologies, including quantum random-number generation and secure key distribution.

title: Eye Tracking in Mixed Reality
description: Leading research into gaze-based control and interaction with objects in mixed-reality environments.

sourceTitle: Systemy wizyjne XR w nauce i obronności
title: XR Vision Systems for Research and Defence
description: Leading research on mixed-reality vision systems for scientific experiments and military applications.

title: RiverGUARD · River-Border Monitoring
description: Work on an optoelectronic monitoring and protection system for river borders in challenging field conditions.

title: 3D Sub-THz Scanner
description: Participation in an active 3D sub-terahertz scanner project for non-contact security screening.

title: GROM / PIORUN Trainer Sensor
description: Development of a sensor for a virtual GROM/PIORUN anti-aircraft system trainer supporting realistic operator training.

title: PROTECT · Border-Control Biometrics
description: A European project exploring less intrusive and more robust border controls through multimodal biometrics and privacy safeguards.
